Excursions.pageIntro: Eight ways to experience Nosy Be differently: secret islands, nature reserves, and encounters with marine wildlife.

nosy-iranja-antsoha.title: Nosy Iranja & Nosy Antsoha
nosy-iranja-antsoha.description: Nosy Iranja is made up of two islets linked by a sandbank that only appears at low tide. Pristine white beach, turquoise water, and sea turtle nesting depending on the season.
highlights: Sandbank connecting the two islands at low tide
Beach lunch under the coconut trees

nosy-komba-village.title: Nosy Komba & local village
nosy-komba-village.description: Island of free-roaming lemurs, where locals live by fishing and craft. A walk through the village before a swim on a quiet beach.
highlights: Stroll through streets lined with local crafts

nosy-tanikely-sakatia.title: Nosy Tanikely & Nosy Sakatia
nosy-tanikely-sakatia.description: A protected marine reserve known for its coral reef, ranked among the world's best snorkeling spots. Green turtles, colourful fish, and crystal-clear water.
highlights: Snorkeling in a protected marine reserve

reserve-lokobe.title: Lokobe Reserve
reserve-lokobe.description: Nosy Be's last primary forest, reached by canoe through the mangrove. Black lemurs, chameleons, and endemic plants in a pristine setting.
highlights: Black lemurs and chameleons in their natural habitat
Local guide specialised in the primary forest

requins-baleines.title: Whale shark watching
requins-baleines.description: From September to December, the waters off Nosy Be host whale sharks, the world's largest fish — harmless and fascinating to observe while snorkeling.
highlights: Boat trip with a specialised guide

baleines-a-bosse.title: Humpback whale watching
baleines-a-bosse.description: From July to September, humpback whales come to calve in the calm waters of Nosy Be bay, putting on an impressive display of breaches and song.
highlights: Observation from the boat, in line with Malagasy regulations
Chance to hear whale song underwater

sejour-sakatia.title: Stay in Sakatia
sejour-sakatia.description: Three days to enjoy Nosy Sakatia at your own pace: hiking through vanilla and ylang-ylang plantations, swimming with turtles, and quiet evenings away from the crowds.

peche-artisanale.title: Traditional fishing & boat trip
peche-artisanale.description: Head out with local fishermen for a traditional outing at sea, combining age-old techniques with a taste of the freshly grilled catch of the day.
highlights: Tasting the day's freshly grilled catch
